scope: Archived public bank replay in fresh test portfolios. The same archival bank value was supplied to the local REST adapter. No separate previously confirmed portfolio position was recorded.

runs.method: The local replay adapts an independently archived ABCI bank result to the LCD bank response. Other endpoints are blocked. This case cannot establish ownership or the original state of a project portfolio.
